ido.question: A workshop charges £0 under age 6, £3 for ages 6–15, and £8 otherwise. Choose a fee from an integer age and display it.
ido.scaffold:
if _____ then
    fee = _____
elseif _____ then
    fee = _____
else
    fee = _____
endif
print(_____)

steps.title: First age band
steps.explanation: The first true condition assigns the free price.

steps.title: Next unmatched band
steps.explanation: After the first branch fails, age < 16 covers ages 6–15.
steps.code:
if age < 6 then
    fee = 0
elseif age < 16 then
    fee = 3

steps.title: Else handles adults
steps.explanation: ELSE covers all remaining values; only one branch runs.
steps.code:
if age < 6 then
    fee = 0
elseif age < 16 then
    fee = 3
else
    fee = 8
endif

steps.title: Print the selected fee
steps.code:
if age < 6 then
    fee = 0
elseif age < 16 then
    fee = 3
else
    fee = 8
endif
print(fee)

wedo.question: A climbing club charges £0 under 5, £6 for ages 5–17, £10 otherwise. Use integer age and print price.
wedo.scaffold:
if _____ then
    price = _____
elseif _____ then
    price = _____
else
    price = _____
endif
print(_____)

steps.title: Under-five group
steps.explanation: The first condition is checked before any other.

steps.title: Second age band
steps.explanation: ELSEIF is only checked if the first IF is false.
steps.code:
if age < 5 then
    price = 0
elseif age < 18 then
    price = 6

steps.title: Complete all branches
steps.explanation: ELSE and ENDIF complete selection; output once.
steps.code:
if age < 5 then
    price = 0
elseif age < 18 then
    price = 6
else
    price = 10
endif
print(price)
